calibration_blocker: No rights-cleared dense metal corpus exists yet. Every value below is a target, not a measured limit, and admission fails while calibrated is false.

reconstruction.description: lead + rhythm against the isolated guitar family

leakage.description: energy of one role lane present in the other

audibility.description: a lane that is not declared absent must carry meaningful signal, never a noise-floor placeholder

role_absence.description: a lane at or below this level is treated as absent and must still satisfy reconstruction; the band between this level and the audibility minimum is a placeholder and fails

perceptual.description: recorded blinded comparison on dense metal material
